In their basements, the Builders made a decision.
They would call a guardian from the souls of the dead, to defeat the Wither.
They spent many years digging below Y level 0.
the Screech Fungus, a fungal life that senses vibration.
No tome recorded it. It was something new.
With the souls of their fallen companions from the Wither war,
and the resonance energy of the Screech Fungus, they raised The Echo Sentinel.
The Echo Sentinel is no monster — it is a security system.
It cannot see. It feels through vibration.
Its purpose: to annihilate every threat.
It rose from the deep, and its vast body fell upon the Wither.
The Wither versus The Echo Sentinel — a death-grapple deep below.
The Echo Sentinel won. The Wither was torn apart, its remains scattered.
The Echo Sentinel itself was badly damaged, and never returned to the deep.
It took its stand at the heart of the Ancient City,
watching by instinct for any sign that might wake the Wither again.
